title: How Far Can Foundation Models Be Distilled for Efficient Jet Tagging?
abstract: arXiv:2610.29439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Jet tagging is one of the most important applications of machine learning at the Large Hadron Collider. Recent models build in more physics knowledge or rely on large-scale pretraining, but the experiments place strict limits on their inference cost. Knowledge distillation can transfer their performance to small students that are cheap to run. We ask which properties of a teacher help the student, how small a student can get and how close it can come to the state of the art. On a jet tagging benchmark, we distil six teachers that differ in architecture, symmetry and pretraining, including two foundation models, into five small students. Every teacher improves every student, and the gain depends mainly on the strength of the teacher. We then shrink our two strongest distilled students, Transformer and L-GATr-slim, in width and in depth. With 20 thousand parameters, a distilled L-GATr-slim outperforms every published jet tagger trained fro

translated_title: 基础模型可以被蒸馏到何种程度以实现高效的喷注标记？
translated_abstract: 喷注标记是大型强子对撞机上机器学习最重要的应用之一。近期的模型要么构建了更多的物理知识，要么依赖于大规模预训练，但实验对其推理成本有严格的限制。知识蒸馏可以将这些模型的性能迁移到运行成本低廉的小型学生模型中。我们探讨了教师的哪些特性能够帮助学生、学生模型可以小到什么程度，以及它能够多接近最先进的水平。在一个喷注标记基准上，我们将六个在架构、对称性和预训练方面各不相同（其中包括两个基础模型）的教师模型蒸馏到五个小型学生模型中。每个教师都能提升每个学生的性能，且提升幅度主要取决于教师的强弱。随后，我们在宽度和深度上进一步缩减了我们两个最强的蒸馏后学生模型——Transformer和L-GATr-slim。仅用两万个参数，蒸馏后的L-GATr-slim就超越了所有已发表的从头训练的喷注标记器……
tldr: 本研究系统地将六个教师模型（包括两个基础模型）蒸馏到小型学生模型中用于喷注标记，发现每位教师都能提升每位学生且增益主要取决于教师强弱，而仅两万参数的蒸馏版L-GATr-slim即可超越所有已发表的从头训练的喷注标记器。
en_tdlr: This work systematically distills six teachers, including two foundation models, into small student models for jet tagging, showing that every teacher improves every student with gains mainly driven by teacher strength, and that a distilled L-GATr-slim with only 20 thousand parameters outperforms every published jet tagger trained from scratch.
